column1: # Synthetic throughout. No row describes a real person: the names are
# constructed to collide, and that is the whole point. Real collisions live in
# the frozen linkage, which is person-level and gitignored, so a corpus that
# could run in public CI had to be built rather than sampled.
# Each row is a ROSTER record and a CANDIDATE record that a matcher might pair.
# The expectations are what this repository's identity functions ACTUALLY
# return today, frozen so a change has to be deliberate:
#   distinguishable whether ANY available evidence separates this pair. "no"
#                   means the pair is ambiguous BY CONSTRUCTION -- there is
#                   nothing to resolve on -- and a matcher that picks a winner
#                   is manufacturing a distinction the data does not contain.
# Adding a row is cheap and encouraged. Changing an expectation is a decision.
